sources: SUNDAY CARRY-FORWARD RUN: captured Sun Sep 20 2026. NO NEW MARKET DATA SINCE THE PREVIOUS RUN. Global markets have been closed since Friday Sep 18's close, which the Saturday Sep 19 run already captured, and no weekly or monthly US macro release prints on a Sunday (NFCI publishes Wednesdays, initial claims Thursdays, ISM Oct 1, UMich final Sep 25). Every one of the 19 indicator values below is therefore CARRIED UNCHANGED from the Sep 19 run; only the timestamp has advanced. VERIFICATION DONE THIS RUN: Brent Sep 18 settle re-confirmed at 103.21 (TradingEconomics) with CNBC quoting a 103.87 settle - a ~0.6% vendor discrepancy, value left at 103.21 for series continuity with the FRED/TradingEconomics history. VIX 14.81 for Sep 18 re-confirmed (Cboe via multiple vendors), down from 15.44 on Sep 17 and 17.71 at Wednesday's FOMC peak. HY OAS re-confirmed in the 270-276bp band for mid-September (FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 via TradingEconomics); 270 retained. BDTI and MOVE could not be re-verified with a dated Sunday quote and are carried at their Sep 18 vendor prints (4,899 and 80.64). STANDING PICTURE (unchanged from Sep 19, restated): the Fed hiked 25bp on Wed Sep 16 into a post-spike oil market - Brent peaked at 130.80 on Sep 15 (FRED DCOILBRENTEU) and collapsed to 103.21 by Friday. 2s10s at 0.25 is the flattest of the cycle, 15bp of flattening in a fortnight. 5y5y breakevens 2.35% sit at the top of the month-long 2.31-2.35 band. Credit at 270bp, VIX at 14.81 and NFCI at -0.56 (loosest of cycle) show markets still not engaging with policy risk, while BDTI at 4,899 (+81% in a fortnight, YTD +271%) shows the physical tanker market fully engaged. Domestic data remains the soft spot: UMich 47.8 preliminary September (below the 1st percentile of series history, year-ahead inflation expectations 4.6%), LEI y/y approximately -0.7% with the first monthly decline since March, building permits 1,394k in August. Labour still holds: claims 196k, Sahm -0.07. WATCH NEXT WEEK: UMich final September (Sep 25), NFCI (Wed), initial claims (Thu), whether 2s10s keeps flattening toward zero, whether BDTI holds above 4,000 or mean-reverts with crude, and whether HY OAS breaks 300. CAVEATS: this is a carry, not a fresh observation - treat all 19 values as Friday Sep 18 closes or earlier. MOVE is medium confidence (single free vendor). EUR/USD 3M xccy basis at -10bp remains a carried assumption with no live free source. LEI y/y is derived from published m/m and 6m growth rates. ISM (Aug, 54.6) and building permits (Aug) are monthly carries. SOURCES: FRED/St. Louis Fed (T10Y2Y, T5YIFR, VIXCLS, BAMLH0A0HYM2, DCOILBRENTEU, DGS10, SOFR, EFFR, NFCI, ICSA, SAHMREALTIME, PERMIT, UMCSENT, WALCL), Chicago Fed, TradingEconomics (Brent, DXY, HY OAS), CNBC (Brent), Cboe/StockQ (VIX), Baltic Exchange via StockQ (BDTI), MacroMicro (ICE BofA MOVE), University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers, Conference Board LEI, ISM, Census Bureau/HUD.
